n: 20 Cu. Ft. Counter-Depth French Door Refrigerator
desc: This Frigidaire 33" French Door refrigerator with an internal water dispenser keeps produce fresh for longer with our CrispSeal® crispers and has a place for everything with our flexible organization system.
hl: Fresh, filtered water right from your internal dispenser, while allowing for a clean exterior look.
Keep produce fresher longer, so you waste less and save money.
Enhanced storage in a compact design
33 in. wide French Door easily fits smaller spaces yet provides storage for all your favorites.
Our adjustable large door bins offer more storage, without sacrificing valuable shelf space.
Keep safer, great tasting water flowing and reduce up to 99% of contaminants while cutting back on plastic and the cost of bottled water with our water filter.
Prevent warm spots and unwanted freezing with our cooling system that optimizes airflow to ensure a consistent temperature throughout your refrigerator.
